title: 3512. Minimum Operations to Make Array Sum Divisible by K

examples.explanation: Perform 4 operations on nums[1] = 9. Now, nums = [3, 5, 7]. The sum is 15, which is divisible by 5.
The sum is 8, which is already divisible by 4. Hence, no operations are needed.
Perform 3 operations on nums[0] = 3 and 2 operations on nums[1] = 2. Now, nums = [0, 0]. The sum is 0, which is divisible by 6.
